notEstablished.mediumOfInstruction: Not established from the sources consulted. The Education Act 2006 carries no medium-of-instruction provision, naming language only among what schooling should promote understanding of and in the English Language pass required of teachers, and the Garifuna Heritage Foundation's 2024 programme runs teacher workshops and cultural exchanges without naming any classroom language.
